note: Rule fixtures are synthetic. A status of NOT VERIFIED means no labeled field clip exists, so the UI and README must say so.

alerts.title: Wild animal enters the pen
alerts.expect: Fires only after the wild animal has stayed inside the zone for sustain_s.

alerts.title: Farm animal leaves the pen
alerts.expect: Fires only after the farm animal has stayed outside the zone for sustain_s, and only if it was inside first.

alerts.title: Person stays in a protected zone
alerts.expect: Message is 'Person detected in protected zone at HH:MM'. Label is 'Possible intrusion — needs review'. No identity fields. No notice to authorities.
